name: principle-attack-the-premise
purpose: Question a shared premise after repeated failed fixes, census actor imbalance and remove persistent role asymmetry.
triggers: Two or more fixes sharing one premise fail the same gate
outputs: Written premise and rerunnable actor census
Role-assignment diagnosis or evidence directing investigation elsewhere
ordinaryExample: After two balancing fixes fail, count which workers retain excess load across runs and trace the assignment that keeps selecting them.
capabilityLimits: Census creation requires authorized writes and execution requires an available tool.
Unavailable writes or execution allow a census proposal, with no claim it exists or ran.
Missing actor or failed-check evidence blocks diagnosis.
Invocation metadata enforcement and host behavior remain unverified.
